node.title: Re^2: Problem with perlcritic when using Moose object
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The Perl parser could confuse the bareword shift in the braces with its core function [doc://shift] instead of converting it to a string.

I'm pretty sure that Perl will always take $hash{shift} to mean the hash key "shift", although adding any other characters will change that ($hash{+shift}, $hash{shift()}, etc.) [id://1191596|See also.]
